sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at my hotel, ready to go out.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My clothes are in a basket, but the iron's cold.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, I'm in room twelve, and I've got a problem.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry about that, what isn't working in your room?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The iron I borrowed this afternoon doesn't heat up.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, thanks for telling me, is anything else wrong?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The cord looks fine, but the iron stays cold.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sounds faulty, let's get you a working one instead.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll turn it off and stop using it.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, leave it there for now, and I'll check.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the hotel's help page while waiting.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says faulty equipment is replaced at no extra cost.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, you won't need to pay for another iron.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, can I pick up another one at reception?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Let me see when we've got a spare one ready.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'd like to iron my shirt before dinner.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, I'll see what we can do for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, can I leave the faulty one in my room?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, we'll take it away, so leave it there.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, and I'll keep my clothes in the basket meanwhile.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, I'll get the replacement ready soon.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The receptionist comes back with two options.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The spare's ready at nine, but room delivery won't work till ten.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what time can I pick it up myself?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Nine for pickup, ten for room delivery.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll pick it up at nine, then, before dinner.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, come to reception and tell me your room number.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: And that's at no extra cost, right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, we'll swap it for a working one.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll come down at nine to pick it up.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, and sorry again about the faulty iron.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've reported the problem and arranged a replacement.
